description: This file defines an abstract class CodeRenderer that implements methods for escaping CDATA sections and generating HTML elements with embedded code blocks for Confluence markdown rendering.

classes.name: CodeRenderer
classes.description: An abstract class responsible for rendering code blocks in Confluence markdown format, implementing NodeRendererInterface.

methods.name: escapeCDATA
methods.description: Replaces the CDATA ending sequence to prevent premature termination inside CDATA sections.

methods.name: getHTMLElement
methods.description: Generates an HTML element structure for a code block with optional language specification, formatted for Confluence.
